I can't see the repository, so this comes from memory of the open-source Dispatch codebase and may be wrong. Please check it against the code before relying on it.

- **Function:** I believe the counts come from a helper in the on-call shift feedback code, which I recall living in the feedback scheduled-task module. It queries incidents and cases where the person was the commander or assignee during the shift window.
- **Fallback window:** If the paging tool doesn't report when the shift began, I recall it falling back to a fixed lookback of about a week. That is a guess based on typical weekly rotations, not something I remember reading.
- **Other projects:** I believe the queries are scoped to the single project the on-call schedule belongs to, so incidents they led in other projects of the same organization would not be counted. I'm not certain of this.

The path and function name below are my best guesses, not confirmed.

FILE: src/dispatch/feedback/service/scheduled.py
FUNCTION: get_oncall_shift_incidents_and_cases
FALLBACK_WINDOW: 7 days
OTHER_PROJECTS: no
